info.biography: 字建阳，泰山郡南城县人。东汉末年军阀、权臣。丁原出任并州刺史时，屯兵于河内郡。在策划谋杀十常侍不成导致宦官被谋杀后，与西凉军阀董卓在皇帝废立问题上产生矛盾，于是董卓利诱吕布将其杀害，其地盘势力亦被董卓兼并。

rulesMapping.cixiao: One global adopted-child marker. Initial appointment excludes the owner; transfer excludes the current holder and permits the owner because the transfer clause does not say other. Transfer pays one ordinary HE discard before choosing its successor. Marker-derived Panshi persists if the Cixiao skill is lost; independent Panshi grants survive marker transfer.
rulesMapping.panshi: Mandatory own preparation hand gift to one currently living other Cixiao holder. The Slash is stamped at actual own Play use. Its +1 enters ordinary damage before caps. Issued native damage and its phase-end consequence survive subsequent marker/skill loss; no end is issued if damage is prevented. Multiple Cixiao holders are selected from current living holders. The historical OL operator FAQ requires a direct Slash target: a chained father receives propagated damage without a Panshi trigger; a directly increased elemental Slash propagates its finalized amount normally.
rulesMapping.xianshuai: Only the first actual positive sourced damage globally in an actual round qualifies. One draw per owner; if that owner was the source, a separate ordinary one-point damage follows to the same target. Source-less HP/damage does not claim this caused-damage timing. The issued trigger uses high native after-damage priority so its inserted damage resolves before ordinary after-damage benefits and propagation.
rulesMapping.interpretationBoundary: No additional current official FAQ found for multiple Cixiao or transfer-to-owner. Those mappings follow current client wording. Historical OL operator FAQ is separately labeled for loss, chain damage and insertion order.

operatorFaqSupplement.scope: Historical operator gameplay FAQ supplements the current official client skill text; it is not presented as a current official FAQ revision.

findings.panshiChain: The operator FAQ explicitly requires Ding Yuan to be the direct Slash target. The increased direct elemental damage propagates normally, while damaging Ding Yuan only by elemental propagation cannot trigger Panshi.
findings.cixiaoLoss: The adopted-child marker and granted Panshi persist after Cixiao is lost; Panshi has no effective recipient when no Cixiao holder remains.
findings.xianshuaiOrder: After original dying handling, the separate Xianshuai damage is inserted before elemental propagation and ordinary after-damage benefit skills.
